Name: BeeboScore Prototype
Author: Beebo
Description: Run the BeeboScore fighting game scoreboard from your Stream Deck: live score keys, reset, swap sides, undo, losers [L], the VS and Victory Splashes, hide all splashes, refresh the overlay in OBS, game formats (format keys that change with the running format, confirm & next match, undo, splashes, the format bar, Team Death Battle switches), and start.gg: next match, set player, report results and refresh. Comes with ready-made layouts for the Stream Deck (15 keys) and the Stream Deck XL (32 keys).

Actions.Name: Player score
Actions.Tooltip: Tap +1, hold −1. Shows the player's name and live score.

Actions.Name: Reset scores
Actions.Tooltip: Both scores back to 0–0.

Actions.Name: Swap sides
Actions.Tooltip: Swap Player 1 and Player 2.

Actions.Name: Undo
Actions.Tooltip: Undo the last change.

Actions.Name: Clear players
Actions.Tooltip: Clears both players and scores for the next set.

Actions.Name: Losers [L]
Actions.Tooltip: Mark a player as coming from losers.

Actions.Name: Show / hide overlay
Actions.Tooltip: Hides the whole overlay in OBS during downtime; press again to bring it back.

Actions.Name: Show / hide VS Splash
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the VS Splash over the scoreboard; press again to hide it. The key lights up while the splash is on stream.

Actions.Name: Switch layout
Actions.Tooltip: Next layout, or a specific one (including layouts you made in the Overlay maker).

Actions.Name: Report result to start.gg
Actions.Tooltip: Sends the finished set's result to start.gg (the match has to come from the start.gg bracket, and your account has to be able to report).

Actions.Name: Refresh start.gg matches
Actions.Tooltip: Pull the latest matches and results from start.gg right now.

Actions.Name: Set player
Actions.Tooltip: Pop-up to type a name or pick a player.

Actions.Name: Next match (start.gg)
Actions.Tooltip: Load the next match from start.gg at 0–0.

Actions.Name: Format · Confirm & next match
Actions.Tooltip: Game formats: the battle score; press to confirm a won set and load the next match.

Actions.Name: Format · Undo result
Actions.Tooltip: Game formats: undo the last recorded result.

Actions.Name: Format · Splash (board / team VS / champion)
Actions.Tooltip: Game formats: show / hide the board, Team VS or champion splash.

Actions.Name: Format · Format bar
Actions.Tooltip: Show / hide the format bar along the bottom of the layout (teams, survivors, challengers, standings). Lit while on stream.

Actions.Name: Format · Switch fighter
Actions.Tooltip: Team Death Battle: after a life is lost, puts the team's next fighter in (they keep their lives). Set P1 or P2.

Actions.Name: Show / hide Victory Splash
Actions.Tooltip: The set winner, full screen. Lit gold while it is on stream.

Actions.Name: Hide all splashes
Actions.Tooltip: Takes every full-screen splash off (VS, Victory, Board, Team VS, Champion). The scoreboard stays.

Actions.Name: Refresh overlay in OBS
Actions.Tooltip: Reloads the overlay in OBS so it starts clean. Through the OBS link it fades over, with no visible reload.

Actions.Name: Format key (changes with the format)
Actions.Tooltip: Part of the BeeboScore Stream Deck layouts: becomes what its place is for in the running format (Confirm & next match, Switch fighter, Board…), framed in the format's colour.
